root: ^Bartolomeu: Ah, there you are! You've defeated Vella, haven't you? I can already feel the island breathing differently.
^Loras: Already drinking, are we? Look at it—dripping between your bones… such a waste of fine mead, Bartolomeu!
^Bartolomeu: No matter! What a joyous day this is… a toast! A toast to you all. I’ve even invited my friends to celebrate…
^Bartolomeu: Isn’t it beautiful? A champion’s cup. For you. It’s yours… our gift!
^Loras: Shiny, isn’t it? I bet you could sell that for a good coin.
^Cacildes: Thank you, Bartolomeu. I’m glad I could be of service to the island.
^Loras: Ah… it seems my departure is also at hand. Thank you for looking after me. I’ll be fine here with Bartolomeu… I think!
^Cacildes: Very well! Friends reunited, at last.
^Bartolomeu: When you tire of celebrating, simply take the cup and the party will end. Until then… enjoy. You’ve truly earned it.
